meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把你抛出的问题查透,交付带出处和质检的结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对复杂问题想要得到论证充分的结论
copy.tagline_en: Conduct exhaustive research on any topic and return a cited, QA'd report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a deep, verified answer to any hard question

howto.what: 要求做深度研究时，Claude 会进入饱和式研究：拆解问题、组建虚拟团队分头查证并互相辩论，必要时用代码验证争议，最终交出每个主张都有引用或验证的深度报告；全程实时记录，并先询问你想要的交付格式。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-research”“ultradebate”“hyperdebate”等词，或用任何语言明确要求做研究、深度调查、超精确查证时触发。普通问题或调试不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 帮我彻查一下“室温超导”的最新进展。
say.note: 会启动饱和式研究并产出带引用的报告。

say.text: 对这个开源库做一次超精确调查，验证它的性能声明。
say.note: 会安排成员辩论并用代码验证关键结论。

say.text: 请用 ulw 研究模式深挖这份财报里的关键假设。
say.note: 会形成研究团队并全程记录调查过程。

howto.what_en: On research requests, Claude runs saturation research: decomposes the topic, forms a team, debates, codes to test disputes, and delivers a report with each claim cited or verified. It asks format first and journals live.
howto.when_en: Activated when research or deep investigation is requested, e.g., "ulw-research", "ultradebate", "hyperdebate", etc., in any language. Ordinary questions/debug don't trigger.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to deep-dive into room-temperature superconductivity.
say_en.note: It will launch saturation research and return a cited report.

say_en.text: Deep-investigate this open-source library's performance claims.
say_en.note: Members will debate and key claims will be verified by code.

say_en.text: Use ulw research to probe this report's key assumptions.
say_en.note: It will form a team, chase leads, and log the whole process.
